# Brazil state boundaries

Source: [Click That 'Hood — Brazil states](https://github.com/codeforgermany/click_that_hood/blob/main/public/data/brazil-states.geojson).

Downloaded on 2026-10-19. Includes all 26 states and the Federal District.
Coordinates rounded to four decimal places for a smaller local file; only the
name, UF abbreviation and IBGE code properties are retained. State polygons are
reference outlines and do not change country assignment or travel statistics.
